The Investment

A day this honest
deserves to be told well.

Not posed. Not performed. Just your wedding, as it actually happened — captured by someone who knows when to disappear.

Philosophy

Documentary first. Always.

I don't direct moments — I wait for them. My approach is rooted in observation: real laughter, real nerves, the glance no one was meant to see. Fifteen years in, I've learned that the most beautiful photographs are the ones nobody had to ask for.

The Experience

What working together looks like.

01

Before

A real conversation about your story, your people, and how the day will unfold — so that on the day itself, nothing feels unfamiliar.

02

During

I move quietly through the day. No stopping for poses, no directing the room — just steady, attentive presence from getting ready to the last dance.

03

After

A careful, unhurried edit. Every photograph is selected and finished to tell the truth of your day — delivered through a private gallery you'll return to for years.

FAQ

Questions worth answering up front.

How far in advance should we book?

Most couples reach out 8–12 months before their date, especially for the Chilean spring and summer (October–March). Dates are held on a first-deposit basis.

Do you travel for destination weddings?

Yes — I travel throughout Chile and internationally. Destination weddings are quoted individually based on location, travel days, and what the day requires.

What's included in a wedding collection?

Coverage hours, a photographer (or photographer plus assistant), edited high-resolution photos, and a private online gallery — details are confirmed once we talk about your day.

How long until we receive our photos?

A sneak peek within 24–48 hours, and the full gallery within 15–30 days depending on the collection.

How do we secure our date?

A deposit of 30–50% reserves your date once we've agreed on a proposal. The rest is due upon delivery of the photographs.

Let's talk about your day.

Tell me your date and where it's happening — I'll put together a proposal built around your story.
